internal.for.what: Loops over a list; runs the child steps once per item. Current item is {{steps.<id>.item}}.

internal.ifCondition.what: Branches on a condition; the child ifTrueBranch / ifFalseBranch steps hold the two paths.

internal.if.what: Legacy if: branches via transitions on true/false.

internal.ifTrueBranch.what: Steps run when the parent condition is true.

internal.ifFalseBranch.what: Steps run when the parent condition is false.

internal.while.what: Repeats child steps while the condition holds (bounded by max_iterations).

internal.try.what: Runs child steps; if one fails, control goes to the sibling internal.catch.

internal.catch.what: Error handler for the preceding internal.try.

internal.SetVariable.what: Stores a value in a workflow variable, read later as {{variables.<Name>}}.

internal.SetVariables.what: Stores several workflow variables at once.

internal.append_list.what: Appends an item to a workflow list variable.

internal.Sleep.what: Pauses the workflow for a duration.

internal.EndRun.what: Ends the run early with a status.

internal.print.what: Writes text to the run log / step output.

internal.switchCaseExpression.what: Switch: evaluates an expression and runs the matching case label.

core.bash.reads: Whatever the script reaches (network, files); no Blink connection

core.python.reads: Whatever the script reaches; no Blink connection

core.aws.reads: AWS APIs via the AWS connection

core.az.reads: Azure APIs via the Azure connection

core.gcloud.reads: GCP APIs via the GCP connection

core.kubectl.reads: Kubernetes API via the Kubernetes connection

core.terraform.reads: Cloud APIs via the Terraform/cloud connection

core.git.reads: Git remote via the Git/GitHub connection

core.fetch_file.what: Downloads a file for later steps.
core.fetch_file.reads: The file URL given in the inputs

system.AskQuestionViaSlack.what: Asks a question in Slack and waits for a button answer (human approval).
system.AskQuestionViaSlack.reads: Slack workspace via the Slack connection

system.AskQuestionViaEmail.what: Asks a question by email and waits for an answer.

system.AskQuestionViaTeams.what: Asks a question in Microsoft Teams and waits for an answer.

system.TableSelect.what: Reads rows from a Blink Table.

system.TableInsert.what: Inserts rows into a Blink Table.

system.TableUpdate.what: Updates rows in a Blink Table.
